heroImage.licenseNote: Street-level shot of the colonial historic center's cobblestone streets and whitewashed facades, taken 2014-05-01, CC BY 2.0 — shows the actual streetscape (uneven stone, low buildings, no cars) that this piece's access-and-hype angle is about. No gallery: the Commons categories for Paraty are mostly repetitive postcard-angle shots of the same church and street corner, not enough distinct compositions to clear the gallery bar.

statusHistory.note: LUGARDO KARAI piece for the coastal-alt-luxury beat. Left as status: draft per the task brief pending explicit operator review before publish. Geocode is a manual approximate placement for the historic center (confidence 0.5) — should be refined to a specific landmark point (e.g. the Igreja de Santa Rita or the main pier) before going active. Covers Paraty town itself as the access hub, with its real remote-beach payoff (Praia do Sono, Saco do Mamanguá) as the honest 'what it's a gateway to' angle rather than a separate page — no dedicated pages exist yet for those beaches to NearLink to. No natural NearLink found: praia-do-bonete-ilhabela is a different state (São Paulo) and a genuinely different access profile (trail/boat to an inhabited caiçara village vs. Paraty's colonial port town), so no cross-link was forced. heroImage set via a CC BY 2.0 Wikimedia Commons street photo of the historic center; no illustration was needed since a genuine, on-topic photo was found.
